notes.title: New PLAYISM Title: Giraffe and Annika Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear PLAYISM fans,

We are writing to inform you that today marks the release of our newest title.

Heartfelt 3D Action+Rhythm Action game, Giraffe and Annika.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122100/Giraffe__Annika/

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r2PcSX7iinw

Set on Spica Island, enjoy the sights and sounds as you embark on a journey packed with 3D platforming action, adventure, and rhythm game boss fights!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/ea5cafad264aac0053fa8150484c26945a023871.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/311fa9b4c2a07e69510dbd7835c3e014fd0335a9.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/44215ecb8f1da94cfd33ee8e8323561db2b65a6f.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/a155b8b4391c3107f29bbf4588b444a20f1eabeb.jpg[/img]

Soundtrack also available!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1241210/Giraffe_and_Annika_Original_Sound_Track/

notes.title: Update - Ver. 3.02
notes.notes:
Hi all

We've just updated Astebreed: Definitive Edition. You can see the details of the update below.

[h1]Update Details[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Adjusted the Mouse directional lock sensitivity in Arrange Mode.
    [*]The bug in which interference could be heard when playing in an environment with audio output of 7.1ch or higher has been fixed.
[/list]

We hope that you continue to enjoy Astebreed: Definitive Edition. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/283680/Astebreed_Definitive_Edition/

notes.title: Update - Ver. 3.01
notes.notes:
Hi All

We have updated Astebreed: Definitive Edition to include the following changes: 

[h1]Update Details:[/h1]
[list][*]Keyboard/Mouse play now works in Arrange mode (Key mapping is added to the config screen)
[*]Pad config UI issue fixed.
[*]Fixed the display error in the rankings.[/list]

We hope that you continue to enjoy Astebreed: Definitive Edition! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/283680/Astebreed_Definitive_Edition/

notes.title: Halloween Sales & Upcoming Major Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone

Today we are beginning our Halloween sale. Astebreed will available at 67% off for one week.

This is a great time to discover this dazzling fast-paced 2.5D gem of a shooting game.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/283680/Astebreed/

[h1]We are preparing to make a BIG update very soon, so here are the details:[/h1]
[list][*]Addition of "Arranged mode" that was a PS4 exclusive; high-quality boost to models, shaders and textures; optimization of compressed data, resource format. In short, all data will be improved over the previous version.
[*]Artwork, package design etc. that was created since the PS4 release will be added to the artwork gallery. 
[*]The game will be playable in Simplified Chinese!
[*]Your online rank will be independent from the previous version.
[*]As we removed full screen check upon starting up the game for the first time, the entire game now has full controller support.[/list]

The upgraded version is scheduled to raise the base price to 19.99 USD, so this is the best opportunity to buy the game at a bargain price.
